title: Make exact True the canonical Boolean admission common path

research_basis.decision: GPU-24 reduced persisted scalar admission to one sequence owner. In the Boolean persisted contract, exact True is the only admissible non-zero scalar, so the valid common path can use identity directly without retaining a second validator or helper.

implementation.production_change: In the existing _stored_values Boolean branch, exact True is now the valid common path. False still fails as semiring zero, while every non-bool still fails the exact-bool contract. The old generic type-check-plus-truthiness sequence is not retained beside it.
implementation.gardening: No new helper, validator, cache, registry, trusted constructor, backend, relation type, workflow path, profiler schema, or benchmark harness was added. The existing sequence owner remains the sole persisted scalar authority.
implementation.profiler_contract: The existing daedalus-tensor-typed-block-validation-profile/8 schema remains unchanged; only its explanatory narrative was bound to the GPU-25 production common path.

focused_semantic_evidence.boolean_valid_path: Exact True remains admissible and existing Boolean tuples remain reusable without rematerialization.
focused_semantic_evidence.boolean_zero: Exact False retains the relation-block semiring-zero refusal.
focused_semantic_evidence.boolean_foreign_type: Non-bool inputs retain the exact bool-type refusal; a focused exploding-truthiness regression proves foreign __bool__ is not invoked.
focused_semantic_evidence.other_semirings: Natural, Tropical, EvidenceDag and unsupported-semiring behavior remain on the existing GPU-24 paths and focused regression surface.

post_change_diagnostic.interpretation: These are post-change diagnostics from the exact code/test-head run. GPU-25 did not run a same-process pre/post constructor A/B, and cProfile contains observer overhead, so cross-run differences from GPU-24 are not treated as a speedup claim.

claim_boundary.allowed: GPU-25 establishes a smaller exact-Boolean valid common path inside the existing single scalar-admission owner, with focused semantic regression, hash-seed matrix, integrated-contract, wheel, repository-collection and retained post-change diagnostic evidence.

closure.note: This seed head first introduced the closed Work Packet record after the verified code/test and profiler-narrative commits. The final branch head is verified independently after this metadata binding commit.

next_narrow_step: If still before 2026-09-29, use active v8 attribution to select a remaining end-to-end canonical materialization cost or a higher-priority bounded Fourfold/Tensor issue. Do not add a second Boolean validator or restore the deleted per-entry scalar authority.
